text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that U-turns be prohibited on Southlawn Drive between Buena Vista Avenue and Bellefontaine Street. An all-way stop control is not justified at the intersection of Southlawn Drive and Belgreen Avenue as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device at this time.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turns at all times on Southlawn Drive, between Buena Vista Avenue and Bellefontaine Street. 2. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Southlawn Drive and Belgreen Avenue.
